prompt_text: ROLE AND EXPECTATIONS: Build a complete, working application called COHORTIQ (now Cohortly)... produce 1. Architecture proposal, 2. Database relationship plan, 3. Metric definitions, 4. Implementation sequence, 5. Acceptance checklist.
purpose: Project kick-off and initial architecture/implementation proposal.
engineer_review: Reviewed challenge requirements across all 20 sections, verifying 10 entities, 4 anomaly cases, fixed seed (20261022), starter vs full scale presets, and role visibility.
modifications_made: Drafted initial implementation_plan.md artifact detailing full system architecture, entity relationships, metrics, and 9-phase sequence.
validation_method: Inspected workspace and verified Python 3.11, Node 22, npm 10, git availability.

prompt_text: Cohortly - Required Implementation Plan Corrections (Project naming to Cohortly, correct timezone anomaly detection, two-tier event deduplication, outcome history preservation, unenrolled event ID convention, WAER calculation consistency, synthetic data reference clock reproducibility, decoupled lifecycle validation, instructors entity, ground truth isolation, performance, explainable diagnostics, and testing).
purpose: Refine technical design according to 13 specific architectural corrections.
engineer_review: Analyzed each critique: timezone mismatch must only flag incorrect stored local dates; two-tier dedup prevents data loss; snapshot versioning preserves outcome history; deterministic reference clock guarantees bitwise reproducibility.
modifications_made: Completely revised implementation_plan.md, updated ERD, refined metric formulas, documented dual event ID formats, and added 13-point test suite.
validation_method: Submitted revised technical design document with full change log for user review.

prompt_text: The revised Cohortly architecture is approved, subject to final refinements: 1. WAER denominator correction (WALER vs WAEER), 2. Cross-entity integrity checks, 3. Explainability terminology rename to Explainable Analytics & Decision Engine, 4. Full-scale batch and streaming processing. Proceed with Phase 1.
purpose: Approve architecture and execute Phase 1 (documentation, schema, data dictionary, metrics, and project setup).
engineer_review: Confirmed dual engagement rate metrics to prevent multi-enrollment skew; defined 5 cross-entity relational checks; renamed engine to reflect deterministic rule-based architecture; verified streaming and batch insertion requirements.
modifications_made: Updated implementation plan with refinements; initialized project scaffolding, documentation directories, environment configurations, and prompt history.
validation_method: File creation and phase-by-phase execution tracking.
